errors.network: Ntitwashoboye kugera kuri MediLink. Reba niba murandasi ikora, wongere ugerageze.
errors.rateLimited: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza amasegonda {{seconds}}, wongere ugerageze.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza umunota umwe, wongere ugerageze.
errors.sessionExpired: Wasohowe. Ongera winjire kugira ngo ukomeze.

validation.emailInvalid: Andika imeyili yanditse neza, urugero: izina@example.rw
validation.termsRequired: Emera amabwiriza yo gukoresha kugira ngo ufungure konti
validation.privacyRequired: Emera itangazo ry’ibanga kugira ngo ufungure konti

landing.title: Shaka ubuvuzi mu Rwanda
landing.heroBody: Shaka ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyemera ubwishingizi bwawe, ufate igihe, maze uhagere igihe cyawe kigeze.

search.title: Shaka ubuvuzi
search.comingSoon: Gushakisha biraza vuba. Kugeza icyo gihe, baza ku kigo cy’ubuvuzi cyawe.

how.title: Uko bikora
how.step1Body: Shakisha ukurikije serivisi, aho uri n’ubwishingizi. Reba ibigo byemera ubwishingizi bwawe.
how.step2Title: Fata igihe cyangwa ujye ku murongo
how.step2Body: Hitamo isaha, cyangwa ujye ku murongo w’uyu munsi ukoresheje telefoni yawe.
how.step3Body: Kurikirana umwanya wawe ku murongo. Tukubwira igihe cyo kuva mu rugo.

trust.title: Amakuru yawe aguma mu Rwanda
trust.body: Amakuru yawe arinzwe, abikwa mu Rwanda, kandi asangizwa gusa ibigo bikuvura.

encrypted.title: Birinzwe
encrypted.body: Abakuvura gusa ni bo bafungura dosiye yawe, kandi ubona uwayifunguye.

verified.title: Ibigo byagenzuwe gusa
verified.body: Buri kigo kigenzurwa hakurikijwe uruhushya rwa Minisiteri y’Ubuzima.

facilities.title: Ku bigo by’ubuvuzi
facilities.body: Cunga umurongo, amadosiye n’inyemezabwishyu ahantu hamwe, kandi abarwayi bakubone byoroshye.

tracker.title: Tegerereza mu rugo, si mu nzira
tracker.body: Nyuma yo gufata igihe cyangwa kujya ku murongo, telefoni yawe ikwereka umwanya wawe n’igihe cyo kuva mu rugo. Ikora no kuri interineti nke.

points.ahead: Umubare w’abakuri imbere, uhinduka ako kanya
points.leave: Igihe cyo kuva mu rugo, ukurikije urugendo rwawe
points.called: Ubutumwa busobanutse n’ijwi iyo ari wowe

tracker.caption: Urugero rwo gukurikirana umurongo kuri telefoni: tike G-023, abantu 4 imbere, hafi iminota 25 kugeza 35.

records.title: Amadosiye yawe ahantu hamwe
records.body: Ibyavuye mu kwivuza kwawe byose bigumana nawe, kuri wowe n’abo mu muryango witaho.

prescriptions.title: Impapuro z’imiti
prescriptions.body: Zerekane kuri farumasi iyo ari yo yose, n’ize ku rupapuro.

qr.title: Bigenzurwa na QR
qr.body: Umuntu wese yagenzura ko inyandiko ari iy’ukuri atabonye amakuru y’ubuzima bwawe.

insurance.a: Yego. Shakisha ukoresheje ubwishingizi bwawe urebe ibigo bubwemera n’ibyo uzishyura.

cost.a: Oya. Gufata igihe, gukurikirana umurongo n’amadosiye yawe ni ubuntu ku barwayi.

privacy.q: Ni nde ubona amakuru y’ubuzima bwanjye?
privacy.a: Abakuvura gusa. Ubona igihe cyose dosiye yawe yafunguwe.

smartphone.a: Yego. Baza ku kwakira: bakwandika bakaguha tike, kandi ugumana nimero yawe ya MediLink.

emergency.title: Ubutabazi bwihuse?
emergency.body: Jya ku ishami ry’ubutabazi bwihuse rikwegereye cyangwa uhamagare 912. MediLink si iy’ubutabazi bwihuse.

login.title: Injira cyangwa ufungure konti
login.intro: Fata igihe cyo kwivuza wirinde gutegereza igihe kirekire.
login.invalidCredentials: Imeyili cyangwa ijambo ry’ibanga si byo. Bisuzume wongere ugerageze.

signup.title: Fungura konti yawe
signup.intro: Bifata nk’umunota umwe. Ubwishingizi n’abagize umuryango wabyongeraho nyuma.
signup.passwordHint: Koresha nibura inyuguti 15. Interuro ngufi yoroshye kwibuka kandi igoye gukeka.
signup.languageHint: Twohereza ubutumwa n’ibyibutsa muri uru rurimi.
signup.consentIntro: Mbere yo gufungura konti yawe, soma ibi:
signup.consentPoint1: Amakuru y’ubuzima bwawe arinzwe kandi abikwa mu Rwanda.
signup.consentPoint2: Ibigo bikuvura gusa ni byo bishobora kubona amadosiye yawe.
signup.consentPoint3: Ushobora gukuramo amakuru yawe cyangwa gusiba konti yawe igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
signup.privacy: Nasomye itangazo ry’ibanga kandi nemeye uko MediLink ikoresha amakuru yanjye
signup.research: Nemeye ko amakuru yanjye atagaragaza uwo ndi we yakoreshwa mu bushakashatsi ku buzima
signup.researchHint: Si ngombwa. Kwanga nta cyo bihindura ku buvuzi bwawe. Ushobora kubihindura nyuma.

home.title: Ahabanza
home.nextVisitEmpty: Nta ruzinduko ruraba. Niwafata igihe cyangwa ukajya ku murongo, bizagaragara hano.
home.verifyEmailBody: Twohereje ihuriro kuri {{email}}. Emeza imeyili yawe mbere yo kubona amadosiye y’ubuzima bwawe.

verify.title: Genzura inyandiko
verify.body: Vuba aha, farumasi n’abakoresha bazashobora kugenzura hano urupapuro rwa muganga, inyemezabwishyu cyangwa icyemezo cy’uburwayi bakoresheje kode cyangwa QR.

forFacilities.title: MediLink ku bigo by’ubuvuzi
forFacilities.body: Kwiyandikisha kw’ibigo kuzatangira mu gice gikurikira. Muzashobora gusaba kuri interineti mugatangira nyuma yo kugenzurwa.

terms.title: Amabwiriza yo gukoresha
terms.body: Amabwiriza yose yo gukoresha azashyirwa hano mbere yo gutangira, mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n’Igifaransa.

privacy.title: Itangazo ry’ibanga
privacy.body: Itangazo ry’ibanga ryose rizashyirwa hano mbere yo gutangira, mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n’Igifaransa.

help.title: Ubufasha
help.body: Inyobora z’abarwayi n’ababitaho ziraza. Nta telefoni igezweho ufite? Baza ku kwakira abarwayi.

forgot.title: Hindura ijambo ry’ibanga
forgot.intro: Andika imeyili yawe. Niba ifite konti, tuzakoherereza ihuriro ryo gushyiraho ijambo ry’ibanga rishya.
forgot.sentBody: Niba hari konti ya {{email}}, ihuriro ryo guhindura riroherejwe. Rikora iminota 30.

reset.title: Shyiraho ijambo ry’ibanga rishya
reset.hint: Nibura inyuguti 15. Interuro ngufi yoroshye kwibuka kandi igoye gukeka.
reset.doneBody: Ijambo ry’ibanga ryahinduwe kandi wasohowe ahantu hose. Injira ukoresheje ijambo ry’ibanga rishya.
reset.invalidLink: Iri huriro ntiryuzuye. Ongera ufungure ihuriro riri muri imeyili, cyangwa usabe irindi.
